name: ai-atomic-workflow
description: Graph-Engineering for Real Engineers: Graphs define workflows; workflows build graphs. Based on mattpocock/skills.

plugins.name: graph-workflow
plugins.description: Core graph-execution skill system — atom-pilot lifecycle loop, atom-phase-handler node dispatch, entry/reference skills, and format references for graphs, skills, docs, and domains.

plugins.name: graph-workflow-extra
plugins.description: Optional release-prep pipeline — analyze proposes the next version and changelog inventory from git history; apply performs the confirmed release writes. Not required for normal operation.

plugins.name: graph-fidelity
plugins.description: Platform-seam signal discipline — single-line per-call discipline echo (identity + progress only), system-resident prompts (PCL + five-scenario enumeration + jcodemunch entry, attached via the SDK attach seam), PCL input marking; R2 context management active via @ai-atomic-workflow/graph-fidelity-context (ADR 0186) — delivered as one module for OMP (ExtensionAPI) and opencode (Plugin).
